message: I remember the time my grandson decided it was a great idea to have a spontaneous camping trip in the backyard. We rushed around, grabbing blankets and snacks, but when it came time to pack the essentials—like water and bug spray—we were left rummaging through the kitchen! 🏕️ It was a hilarious scramble, and we ended up using an old Tupperware as our water jug. It reminded me how important it is to be ready, even for the little adventures. Sometimes, it’s not about having everything perfect, but just being prepared enough to enjoy the moment. What little adventures do you find yourself unprepared for?
